findings_fixed: Separate score from mass. A weighted score cannot be inserted as a normalization mass merely because both use rational scalars. Signed controls do not inhabit the nonnegative-weight refinement.
source_review: The convex Bell argument takes nonnegative weights and a declared total mass. Strict positivity is stronger than required; zero weights are valid. Distinct normalized positive preparations on the same two-label carrier demonstrate nonuniqueness of supplied preparation data, not a universal metatheorem about all distinctions. Signed normalized weights give score6; unnormalized positive weights give score4 at mass2 and obey only the scaled bound.
